mapper.insert: INSERT INTO check_in_record (appointment_id, visitor_id, pass_code_id, check_in_time, gate_id, status) VALUES (#{appointmentId}, #{visitorId}, #{passCodeId}, #{checkInTime}, #{gateId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE check_in_record SET check_out_time = #{checkOutTime}, check_out_gate_id = #{checkOutGateId}, remark = #{remark}, status = 'CHECKED_OUT' WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE check_in_record SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM check_in_record WHERE status = 'CHECKED_IN' ORDER BY check_in_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM check_in_record WHERE status = 'CHECKED_IN'
SELECT * FROM check_in_record WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND status = 'CHECKED_IN' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM check_in_record WHERE check_in_time BETWEEN #{todayStart} AND #{todayEnd}
